title: Hon Hai crosses USD 30.7 billion monthly sales mark for 1st time in September
description: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported on Monday that its monthly sales crossed the NT$1 trillion (~USD 30.7 billion) mark for the first time in September, according to a news report by Focus Taiwan. The milestone came primarily on the back of operational momentum across its cloud and networking division during the ongoing artificial intelligence era.

title: Manipal University Jaipur Organises Four-Day Faculty Development Programme in Collaboration with IIMBx, IIM Bangalore
description: Jaipur (Rajasthan) [India], October 5: The Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE), Manipal University Jaipur, is organising a four-day Faculty Development Programme (FDP) in collaboration with IIMBx, the digital learning foundation of the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore). Based on the theme “3D’s: Design, Develop, Deliver, the programme aims to familiarise faculty members with the complete process of designing and developing online and digital courses. The programme provides hands-on training in course design, digital learning content development, the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), studio-based educational video production, learning activity design, assessment development, and preparing courses for delivery through online platforms. The four-day programme covers the complete journey from course design and content development to AI-enabled activities, studio recording, assessment and course presentation.

title: AI’s Power Appetite Is Forcing Asia to Rethink the Infrastructure Behind Innovation
description: Asian Development Bank President Masato Kanda has called for greater investment in scientific research alongside the infrastructure needed to convert technological advances into wider economic and social gains. His remarks place ADB’s $50 billion Pan-Asia Power Grid Initiative and $20 billion Asia-Pacific Digital Highway within a broader challenge facing the region: expanding electricity and digital capacity while managing resource constraints, unequal access and the risks associated with rapidly advancing artificial intelligence.
